feeds.title: Felicity Heaton
feeds.description: Paranormal romance books by paranormal romance author Felicity Heaton / F E Heaton. Author of the Vampires Realm romance series books, Her Angel romance series books, Vampire Erotic Theatre romance series books, Eternal Mates paranormal romance series books, and other stand alone paranormal and urban fantasy romance novels.

feeds.title: Lucy Mitchell Author Blog
feeds.description: Author Lucy Mitchell's official Blog. Here she shares her tactful insights, writing tips she's learned over the years, details & excerpts of her upcoming books, and some personal reflections. Learn critical knowledge about the art of writing from Lucy through these blog posts.

feeds.title: Mary Kingswood Blog
feeds.description: Mary Kingswood is a British romance author writing regency dramas and romance titles. In her blog, You can find all the books she's read and her reviews on Goodreads under her pseudonym Pauline M Ross. She also posts details about her current novels shes working on and other trivia here.

feeds.title: All About Romance Blog
feeds.description: All About Romance are a team of readers and writers from all over the world who share a love of books, especially those focused on romance. We share book reviews and other articles centered around the romance genre. Discover our latest articles and stay updated.

feeds.title: Sarah Ready Blog
feeds.description: Sarah Ready writes contemporary romance, Chick Lit, romantic comedy, and women's fiction. Follow her blog for the best romance book updates, cover reveals, exciting news about her latest works, and more.

feeds.title: Clare Lydon Blog
feeds.description: Clare Lydon is a lesbian fiction author and lover of Curly Wurlys. Her books have been described as 'romantic, addictive, fabulous!' and she couldn't have put it better herself. Check out her stories, new books, news and more!

feeds.title: Beth Linton Author Blog
feeds.description: Beth Linton is the author of The Guardians' Trust series - fantasy paranormal romance novels that feature passion, adventure, and shapeshifters. Her blog is packed with tips & resources on various aspects of Novel writing. Learn the nuances of Plot structuring, Author interviews and more in the latest posts.

feeds.title: RJ Scott
feeds.description: Home of MM romance author RJ Scott who writes gay romances with a guaranteed happily ever after. He shares snippets from his newest and upcoming books, excerpts, critic reviews of his books, amazon offers and many more in the latest posts. Explore more through the blog about upcoming books, audiobooks, news, reviews, and more.

feeds.title: Suzanne Wright Author Blog
feeds.description: Suzanne Wright talks and writes about Writing, Her books, Facts, and Trivia about her Novels and more. Find Book Excerpts and other exclusive bits in this blog. Suzanne Wright is the published author of paranormal and contemporary romance books, including the Phoenix Pack series and Reaper novels.
